svg.title: From a probability model to a distribution, expected value, variance, and standard deviation
svg.desc: A probability model specifies possible outcomes and their probabilities. A random variable specifies a rule for recording a number. These two inputs together determine the probability distribution. Expected value is calculated from the distribution. Variance uses both the whole distribution and the expected value. The square root of variance is the standard deviation.
